name: TimePicker
label: Time picker
description: Time-of-day field with a dropdown list of selectable times.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text rendered above the trigger

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder shown when no time is selected

props.name: value
props.description: Currently selected time as a 24-hour "HH:MM" string (controlled)

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected time as a 24-hour "HH:MM" string (uncontrolled)

props.name: minTime
props.description: Earliest generated option, as a 24-hour "HH:MM" string

props.name: maxTime
props.description: Latest generated option, as a 24-hour "HH:MM" string

props.name: hourFormat
props.description:
Display format for the trigger and options — the value stays a 24-hour
"HH:MM" string either way. Defaults to the clock `locale` uses: `'12'` in
`en-US`, `'24'` in `en-GB` and `de-DE`.

props.name: locale
props.description:
The BCP 47 locale the times are written in, such as `de-DE`: the clock
`hourFormat` defaults to, and the period words and their place when no
`periodLabels` are given. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else
`en-US`.

props.name: name
props.description:
Form field name. When set, the selected 24-hour "HH:MM" value submits with
an enclosing form through a hidden input (nothing while no value is set,
nothing while disabled), as Dropdown does.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected 24-hour "HH:MM" value

props.name: periodLabels
props.description:
The period suffixes a 12-hour time is written with, as "2:30 PM".
Without them a 12-hour time is written the way `locale` writes it,
period words included ("2:30 PM" in `en-US`). A partial set is merged
over the English `{ am: 'AM', pm: 'PM' }`. Only read when `hourFormat`
is `'12'`.

props.name: className
props.description:
Additional CSS classes, applied to the Field wrapper around the label,
trigger and helper text, not to the trigger button the ref and the other
props reach.
